name: Work Session Tracker Lite
description:
Work Session Tracker Lite for Corsair XENEON Edge.

Keep the thing you are working on visible under your monitor without turning your day into a Pomodoro schedule or another countdown. Name the current session or project, start working, and the widget keeps the project name, real elapsed focus time and focused time today visible at a glance.

Pause and resume as often as needed. Paused time is excluded automatically. Finish a session and it joins today's timeline, where gaps between sessions stay visible instead of being hidden inside one total.

Time is derived from persisted timestamps rather than an in-memory second counter. Active sessions recover after widget reloads and iCUE restarts, paused sessions stay paused, and sessions that cross midnight are split correctly into each local calendar day.

Lite includes one active session at a time, custom names, Start, Pause, Resume, Finish, focused time today, today's completed sessions, local persistence, touch controls and tuned layouts for every XENEON Edge dashboard size and orientation.

No account, cloud sync or external service is required. Lite is fully useful on its own. An unobtrusive Pro link is available only for users who want saved projects and longer history.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for Corsair XENEON Edge.
